cv.intro:
Let's create a professional CV! 👇
Answer each question — tap a button or type. It takes about 2 minutes.
cv.exists: You already have a CV. What would you like to do?
cv.cancelled: Stopped. You can continue at any time with the /cv command.
cv.q_category: What field do you work in?
cv.q_region: Which region are you looking for work in?
cv.q_skills: What can you do? Choose a few, then tap “Done”.
cv.q_russian: How well do you know Russian?
cv.q_salary: What salary do you expect (per month)?
cv.h_salary: Tap a button or type, e.g. “6 mln”
cv.q_employment: What kind of work do you need? You can choose several.
cv.h_about: For example: Responsible, friendly, a quick learner.
cv.q_phone: Share your phone number so employers can contact you.
cv.invalid_name: Please enter your full first and last name, e.g. Aziza Karimova
cv.invalid_birth: Please enter the date like this: 15.03.1998
cv.invalid_salary: I didn't understand the amount. For example: 6 mln or 6000000
cv.use_buttons: Please choose one of the buttons 👆
cv.ready:
🎉 Your CV is ready!
You can send the PDF to employers. Your profile is also visible in the app — employers can find you.
cv.save_failed: Couldn't save your CV. Please try again later or fill it in in the app.
cv.pdf_limit: Too many PDFs requested in the last hour. Please try again a bit later.
cv.no_cv: You don't have a CV yet. Let's create one — it takes 2 minutes.

jobs.title: 🔍 Jobs that match you ({from}–{to} of {total}):
jobs.empty: There are no active vacancies for your profession yet. Tap “🔔 Notify me” so we can let you know when new jobs appear.
jobs.alert_done: ✅ We'll message you every morning when new matching jobs appear.
jobs.alert_exists: This search is already saved — you'll receive notifications.
